note: Roadmap and feature requests for the website. status: now | next | later | done. source: who asked (team, user, falak, community).

roadmap.title: App Store and Google Play
roadmap.text: The iPhone and Android apps leave testing and go free on the App Store and Google Play. Phones come first, and every other device joins when it is ready.

roadmap.title: The whole app in Malay and Indonesian
roadmap.text: Every screen in Bahasa Melayu and Bahasa Indonesia, not only the prayer names and Ramadan.

roadmap.title: One place for alerts and alarms
roadmap.text: Set each prayer to Off, Notify or Alarm in one screen, with a check that tells you what might stop it ringing.

roadmap.title: Falak review
roadmap.text: A member of the falak committee in Singapore checks Falak Mode before it loses its 'pending review' label.

roadmap.title: Mac
roadmap.text: The same app on your Mac, with the next prayer in the menu bar and alerts. A Mac has no compass, so the qibla compass stays on the phone.

roadmap.title: Apple Watch and Wear OS
roadmap.text: The next prayer on your wrist, a gentle tap when it is time, and the qibla inside the watch app.

roadmap.title: Windows
roadmap.text: The web app as a Windows app from the Microsoft Store, with the next prayer beside the clock and alerts.

roadmap.title: TV at home
roadmap.text: Today's times on the big screen on Apple TV, Android TV and Google TV.

roadmap.title: Time Sensitive alerts on iPhone
roadmap.text: Prayer notifications that come through a Work or Do Not Disturb Focus, like the alarms already do.

roadmap.title: Masjid screen with local masjids
roadmap.text: Trying the free masjid display screen with a few masjids in Singapore first.

roadmap.title: Badal Haji season
roadmap.text: Order reminders around six months before Aidiladha for Badal Haji.

roadmap.title: Badal.my for Malaysia
roadmap.text: Badal Haji and Umrah for Malaysians, shown to users in Malaysia.

roadmap.title: Masjid timetables
roadmap.text: Jamaah times and Jumaat from local masjids, checked by the community.
